title.zh: 修订第 3846 号法，在其第 1 条与第 2 条之间增设新条，并修订该法第 3、12 与 13 条
title.en: An Act to Amend Act Numbered Thirty-Eight Hundred and Forty-Six By Adding a New Section Between Sections One and Two Thereof and to Amend Sections Three, Twelve and Thirteen of the Same Act.
title.orig: An Act to Amend Act Numbered Thirty-Eight Hundred and Forty-Six By Adding a New Section Between Sections One and Two Thereof and to Amend Sections Three, Twelve and Thirteen of the Same Act.

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 6 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1950/ra_584_1950.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。 源文条号不连续（自第 1 条起，止于第 13 条，缺 4、5、6、7、8、9、10、11）：经逐条比对原始页面，该处原文没有对应的 “Section N.” 抬头行，系来源页自身的编号跳跃或条文以“续段”形式并入前条，非抽取遗漏，故未擅自补号。 源文存在同号重出的条款（第 3 条）：该处官方页面确有两段均标同一 Section 号，本库照录其 `no` 值（不改动官方编号），条文 `id` 以 `_2`「_3」后缀保证唯一。

text.en:
A new section is hereby inserted between sections one and two of Act Numbered Thirty-eight hundred and forty-six, as amended, to read as follows:
"Section 1-A. No person, firm, company, association or corporation shall possess or own radio transmitters or transceivers (combination transmitter receiver), without registering the same with the Secretary of Commerce and Industry, nor sell or transfer the same to another without his prior approval, and no person, firm, company, association or corporation shall construct or manufacture, or purchase radio transmitters or transceivers without a permit issued by the Secretary of Commerce and Industry."

Sections three, twelve, as amended, and thirteen of the same Act are hereby amended to read as follows:
"

Any person who shall violate any provision of this Act, or any regulation prescribed by the Secretary or Commerce and Industry under this Act, or of any provision of the International Radio Regulations, shall be punished by a fine of not more than two thousand pesos or by imprisonment of not more than two years, for each and every offense, or both, in the discretion of the court.
"

Any firm, company, corporation or association failing or refusing to observe or violating any provision of this Act, or any provision of the Regulations prescribed by the Secretary of Commerce and Industry under this Act, or any provision of the International Radio Regulations shall be punished by a fine of not more than five thousand pesos for each and every offense."

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, September 18, 1950.
